message.titanbreak.gravemarch_warning: The ground trembles in slow, heavy intervals. Something immense is approaching.
message.titanbreak.gravemarch_arrival: The Gravemarch Colossus has entered the territory.
message.titanbreak.gravemarch_defeated: The Gravemarch Colossus has fallen. Its impact heart and dense kinetic materials can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.bastion_warning: A low engine pulse travels through the ground. A structure on the horizon is moving.
message.titanbreak.bastion_arrival: The Bastion Walker has begun crossing the territory.
message.titanbreak.bastion_defeated: The Bastion Walker's power core has stopped. Its ultra-dense armor core can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.regnant_warning: A wet pulse spreads beneath the reddened ground. Severed tissue has begun moving again.
message.titanbreak.regnant_arrival: The Regnant Flesh has emerged, drawing regenerative tissue into its body.
message.titanbreak.regnant_defeated: The Regnant Flesh's central brain tissue has collapsed. Its regeneration core and concentrated regenerative materials can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.watcher_warning: Cold points of light begin turning in unison. Your movement is being measured.
message.titanbreak.watcher_arrival: The Hundred-Eyed Watcher has established a prediction field across the territory.
message.titanbreak.watcher_defeated: The Watcher's central visual core has gone dark. Its predictive brain can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.chronophage_warning: The air loses its rhythm. Sound arrives late, and the ground seems to age beneath your feet.
message.titanbreak.chronophage_arrival: The Chronophage has entered the territory. Your time field is no longer uncontested.
message.titanbreak.chronophage_defeated: The Chronophage's central ring has collapsed. Its temporal organ can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.storm_leviathan_warni: The wind locks into one direction and blue discharge crawls across exposed metal. A vast shadow overhead has changed course.
message.titanbreak.storm_leviathan_arriv: The Storm Leviathan has taken the sky. Break its electric sacs and wing membranes to weaken the storm.
message.titanbreak.storm_leviathan_defea: The Leviathan's deep storm organ has gone silent. Its high-output energy materials can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.ash_titan_warning: The far horizon shimmers as soil and stone blacken with heat. A colossal thermal source has begun moving beyond its nest.
message.titanbreak.ash_titan_arrival: The Ash Titan has sealed the area. Breaking its cooling plates exposes the radiant heart, but also raises its thermal output.
message.titanbreak.ash_titan_defeated: The Ash Titan's radiant heart has gone cold. Concentrated radiation and thermal-processing materials can be recovered.
message.titanbreak.null_seraph_warning: Powered systems stutter and targeting traces vanish. A pale silhouette is descending without a sound.
message.titanbreak.null_seraph_arrival: The Null Seraph has entered the territory. Its suppression wings are selecting the systems you rely on most.
message.titanbreak.null_seraph_defeated: The Null Seraph's suppression field has collapsed. Its null core and high-grade neural materials can be recovered.
